pages.text: $(item)Rim Slag$(). Slag thrown off the inner edge of the accretion disk. Quenched with disk plasma in the Tectonic Press, it becomes Accretion Disk Fragments.
$(thing)Found$(): The Accretion Rim, round its plasma lakes.$(br2)$(thing)Used$(): Quenched with Accretion Disk Plasma in the Tectonic Press: Accretion Disk Fragments.
